name: Philistine Territory

related_people.name: Samson
related_people.role: raided and judged among the Philistines for twenty years

related_people.name: Saph
related_people.role: a Philistine giant killed by David's man Sibbecai

related_people.name: Shamgar
related_people.role: struck down six hundred Philistines with an ox goad

description: The coastal region of five allied Philistine cities (Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Gath, and Ekron) that repeatedly warred with Israel, especially during the judges period through Samson's conflicts with them (Judges 13-16) and their capture and forced return of the ark of the covenant (1 Samuel 4-6).
